title: Inbox triage
goal: Classify recent unread mail as URGENT/ACTION/INFO/IGNORE, present a table, and prepare drafts for the URGENT ones without sending anything
done_when: Every unread message in the batch has a category and a confidence level
Each URGENT message has a draft saved (provider draft or .tanka/drafts/)
The summary table and the per-category count have been shown to the user
notes: Template. `tanka run --objective triage-inbox` copies it to .tanka/state/objective.json
